mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_code, market_code, trade_date, provider_quote_time, item_count FROM market_sector_ranking_batch batch WHERE batch.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND batch.market_code = #{marketCode} AND batch.snapshot_type = 'CLOSE' AND batch.quality_status = 'VALID' AND batch.trade_date <= #{asOfDate} AND batch.id = ( SELECT MAX(candidate.id) FROM market_sector_ranking_batch candidate WHERE candidate.provider_code = batch.provider_code AND candidate.market_code = batch.market_code AND candidate.snapshot_type = 'CLOSE' AND candidate.quality_status = 'VALID' AND candidate.trade_date = batch.trade_date ) ORDER BY batch.trade_date DESC, batch.snapshot_time DESC, batch.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, provider_code, market_code, trade_date, provider_quote_time, item_count FROM market_sector_ranking_batch batch WHERE batch.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND batch.market_code = #{marketCode} AND batch.snapshot_type = 'CLOSE' AND batch.quality_status = 'VALID' AND batch.id = ( SELECT MAX(candidate.id) FROM market_sector_ranking_batch candidate WHERE candidate.provider_code = batch.provider_code AND candidate.market_code = batch.market_code AND candidate.snapshot_type = 'CLOSE' AND candidate.quality_status = 'VALID' AND candidate.trade_date = batch.trade_date ) ORDER BY batch.trade_date DESC, batch.snapshot_time DESC, batch.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.batch_id, b.trade_date, i.sector_identity_id, i.rank_no, i.sector_name, i.provider_sector_id, identity.taxonomy_version, i.change_rate, i.leading_name, i.leading_symbol, (SELECT MAX(w.tracking_symbol) FROM market_sector_watch w WHERE w.provider_code = b.provider_code AND w.market_code = b.market_code AND w.provider_sector_id = i.provider_sector_id) AS tracking_symbol FROM market_sector_ranking_item i JOIN market_sector_ranking_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id JOIN market_sector_identity identity ON identity.id = i.sector_identity_id WHERE i.batch_id IN #{id} AND i.sector_identity_id IS NOT NULL AND i.change_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.trade_date, i.provider_sector_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sector_analytics_calculation_run (provider_code, market_code, as_of_date, formula_code, formula_version, window_days, parameter_hash, source_manifest_hash, source_manifest, status, quality_status, reason_codes, sample_size, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{marketCode}, #{asOfDate}, #{formulaCode}, #{formulaVersion}, #{windowDays}, #{parameterHash}, #{sourceManifestHash}, #{sourceManifest}, #{status}, #{qualityStatus}, #{reasonCodes}, #{sampleSize}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sector_analytics_calculation_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', quality_status = #{qualityStatus}, reason_codes = #{reasonCodes}, sample_size = #{sampleSize}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sector_relative_strength_snapshot (calculation_run_id, sector_identity_id, as_of_date, window_days, sector_return, benchmark_return, relative_return, rs_rank_percentile, quality_status, reason_codes) VALUES
(#{item.calculationRunId}, #{item.sectorIdentityId}, #{item.asOfDate}, #{item.windowDays}, #{item.sectorReturn}, #{item.benchmarkReturn}, #{item.relativeReturn}, #{item.rsRankPercentile}, #{item.qualityStatus}, #{item.reasonCodes})

INSERT INTO sector_rotation_sector_persistence (calculation_run_id, sector_identity_id, as_of_date, window_days, current_rank, previous_rank, mean_rank_percentile, rank_percentile_std_dev, top_bucket_occupancy_rate, consecutive_leading_days, consecutive_lagging_days, rank_percentile_change, quality_status, reason_codes) VALUES
(#{item.calculationRunId}, #{item.sectorIdentityId}, #{item.asOfDate}, #{item.windowDays}, #{item.currentRank}, #{item.previousRank}, #{item.meanRankPercentile}, #{item.rankPercentileStdDev}, #{item.topBucketOccupancyRate}, #{item.consecutiveLeadingDays}, #{item.consecutiveLaggingDays}, #{item.rankPercentileChange}, #{item.qualityStatus}, #{item.reasonCodes})

INSERT INTO sector_analytics_publication_batch (provider_code, market_code, as_of_date, window_days, momentum_window_days, formula_version, parameter_hash, required_formula_set_hash, source_manifest_group_hash, scope_code, status, quality_status, published_at) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{marketCode}, #{asOfDate}, #{windowDays}, #{momentumWindowDays}, #{formulaVersion}, #{parameterHash}, #{requiredFormulaSetHash}, #{sourceManifestGroupHash}, #{scopeCode}, #{status}, #{qualityStatus}, #{publishedAt})

INSERT INTO sector_analytics_publication_member (publication_batch_id, calculation_run_id, formula_code, provider_code, market_code, as_of_date) SELECT #{publicationBatchId}, #{calculationRunId}, #{formulaCode}, batch.provider_code, batch.market_code, batch.as_of_date FROM sector_analytics_publication_batch batch JOIN sector_analytics_calculation_run run ON run.id = #{calculationRunId} WHERE batch.id = #{publicationBatchId} AND run.formula_code = #{formulaCode} AND run.provider_code = batch.provider_code AND run.market_code = batch.market_code AND run.as_of_date = batch.as_of_date
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sector_analytics_publication_batch WHERE market_code = #{marketCode} AND window_days = #{windowDays} AND momentum_window_days = #{momentumWindowDays} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: p.id AS publication_batch_id, source_batch.id AS source_batch_id, rs.calculation_run_id, p.provider_code, p.market_code, p.as_of_date, p.window_days, p.momentum_window_days, p.formula_version, p.parameter_hash, p.scope_code, p.quality_status AS publication_quality_status, p.published_at, persistence.calculation_run_id AS momentum_calculation_run_id, source_batch.provider_quote_time, source_batch.item_count AS actual_item_count, identity.id AS sector_id, identity.sector_name, identity.provider_sector_id, identity.taxonomy_version, rs.sector_return, rs.benchmark_return, rs.relative_return, rs.rs_rank_percentile, persistence.current_rank, persistence.previous_rank, persistence.mean_rank_percentile, persistence.rank_percentile_std_dev, persistence.top_bucket_occupancy_rate, persistence.consecutive_leading_days, persistence.consecutive_lagging_days, persistence.rank_percentile_change, source_item.leading_name, source_item.leading_symbol, (SELECT MAX(w.tracking_symbol) FROM market_sector_watch w WHERE w.provider_code = p.provider_code AND w.market_code = p.market_code AND w.provider_sector_id = identity.provider_sector_id) AS tracking_symbol

JOIN sector_analytics_publication_member pm_rs ON pm_rs.publication_batch_id = p.id AND pm_rs.formula_code = 'RELATIVE_STRENGTH' JOIN sector_relative_strength_snapshot rs ON rs.calculation_run_id = pm_rs.calculation_run_id JOIN sector_analytics_publication_member pm_persistence ON pm_persistence.publication_batch_id = p.id AND pm_persistence.formula_code = 'ROTATION_PERSISTENCE' JOIN sector_rotation_sector_persistence persistence ON persistence.calculation_run_id = pm_persistence.calculation_run_id AND persistence.sector_identity_id = rs.sector_identity_id JOIN market_sector_identity identity ON identity.id = rs.sector_identity_id LEFT JOIN market_sector_ranking_batch source_batch ON source_batch.id = (SELECT MAX(source_batch_pick.id) FROM market_sector_ranking_batch source_batch_pick WHERE source_batch_pick.provider_code = p.provider_code AND source_batch_pick.market_code = p.market_code AND source_batch_pick.trade_date = p.as_of_date AND source_batch_pick.snapshot_type = 'CLOSE') LEFT JOIN market_sector_ranking_item source_item ON source_item.batch_id = source_batch.id AND source_item.sector_identity_id = identity.id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sector_analytics_publication_batch p
WHERE p.id = #{publicationBatchId} ORDER BY rs.rs_rank_percentile DESC, identity.id
